search.placeholder: Search a client, a note, a place…
onboard.title: Where should your client book live?
onboard.body: Pick a folder on your computer. Each client becomes a small file in it. You can back it up, copy it, and it stays yours, even without MnemoCRM.
error.title: The client book could not be opened
unreadable.notice.one: 1 file in the folder could not be read as a client: {{names}}
unreadable.notice.many: {{count}} files in the folder could not be read as clients: {{names}}
today.welcome.title: Your book is empty
today.welcome.body: Add your first client. Give them a follow-up date and they will appear here, on the day.
clients.pick: Choose a client on the left.
field.name: Name
consent.label: Agrees to be contacted again
consent.warn: This client said no to being contacted again, and a follow-up is planned.
followup.title: Next follow-up
followup.notInAgenda: Saved here, not in your agenda: {{error}}
followup.refusedAsk: This client said no to being contacted again. If you plan it anyway, the follow-up goes into your agenda and will ring.
followup.refusedReason: this client said no to being contacted again
timeline.title: History
timeline.empty: Nothing written yet. Note the first exchange.
timeline.placeholder: What happened? What was said, promised, asked…
stages.title: Your stages
stages.body: The steps a deal goes through, in your own words.
stages.locked: settings.json in your folder cannot be read. It is left as it is, and nothing will be written over it until it is repaired or removed.
stages.label: Stage name
stages.error.STAGE_NOT_EMPTY: This stage still holds {{count}} open deal(s). Move them first.
stages.error.LAST_STAGE: At least one stage is needed.
deal.totalPartial: Some deals have no amount: this total is a minimum.
deal.title: What is it?
deal.noneForClient: No deal with this client yet.
product.name: Name
product.kindHint.unique: One of a kind: once sold, it leaves the catalogue for sale and stays in your book.
product.kindHint.series: Made several times, with a stock if you want to follow it.
catalog.empty.title: Your catalogue is empty
catalog.empty.body: Add your pieces with a photo: unique pieces and pieces made in series.
journal.broken.HASH: Line #{{seq}} of the sales journal was changed outside MnemoCRM: its content no longer matches its fingerprint.
journal.broken.LINK: The sales journal is broken at line #{{seq}}: it no longer follows the line before it.
journal.broken.GAP: Line #{{seq}} of the sales journal is missing or unreadable.
journal.broken.DUPLICATE: Line #{{seq}} of the sales journal appears twice.
journal.intact.one: Sales journal checked: 1 line, nothing changed outside MnemoCRM
journal.intact.many: Sales journal checked: {{count}} lines, nothing changed outside MnemoCRM
sales.empty.title: No sale written yet
sales.empty.body: Write a sale from the workshop, online or at a market. After a market, you can enter the whole day in one go.
journal.voidBody: The sale stays in the journal, struck through, and a cancellation line is added. The pieces go back in stock.
market.empty.title: No market yet
market.empty.body: A market groups the sales of a Christmas market or a craft fair, and gives the end-of-day report.
tax.ask.title: One question before your sales
tax.ask.body: Are you exempt from VAT (for example a French micro-entrepreneur under the franchise en base)? The answer changes what this screen has to tell you. You can change it later in Stages & settings.
tax.label: Your VAT situation
tax.notice.vat: MnemoCRM is not a certified cash register. In France, a VAT-registered seller who records sales to private customers in software must use a certified or publisher-attested register: keep yours for those sales.
tax.notice.other: MnemoCRM is not a certified cash register. The rules on recording sales differ from one country to another: check the ones that apply to you.
market.cash.title: The cash box
market.cash.body: Cash sales written down: {{amount}}. Count your box and write what you find: the difference is shown, never corrected.
market.cash.match: The box matches the sales written down.
market.cash.more: {{amount}} more in the box than written down: a sale may be missing from the journal.
market.cash.less: {{amount}} less in the box than written down: check the change given and the sales noted twice.
market.name: Name
market.datesInvalid: The last day cannot come before the first.
sale.priceMissing: Every line needs a readable price.
sale.stockNotUpdated: Sale written. The stock could not follow for: {{names}}.
sale.overStock: the stock says {{stock}}, it will go to 0
capture.title: Say what happened
capture.body: Speak or type, as you would to a colleague: who, what was said, what to do next. The model proposes, you check, then one button writes.
capture.callBody: Open a transcript exported by the Recorder (.md or .txt), paste it, or say what was said. The model proposes a summary, you check it.
capture.placeholder: I saw Paul from the Lune café, he wants twelve blue bowls before Christmas, call him back Monday…
capture.fileUnreadable: This file could not be read: {{error}}
capture.dictation.NO_ENGINE: No speech engine is set up. Choose one in Settings › Voice.
capture.dictation.MIC_BUSY: The microphone is used by another window. Try again when it is free.
capture.dictation.NO_SPEECH: Nothing was heard. Speak a little closer, or type instead.
capture.dictation.PERMISSION_DENIED: MnemoCRM was not allowed to use dictation.
capture.modelFailed: The model did not answer: {{error}}. Your text is still here.
capture.costNote: The proposal is written by the model you use in Mnemosyne. A cloud model can use credits.
capture.proposed: Proposed by the model. Check everything before writing.
capture.needClient: Choose the client this is about.
capture.dealInvalid: The deal needs a title, and a readable amount if one is typed.
capture.dealNotSaved: The deal could not be written.
know.title: What we know
know.hint: A summary before you call: what to remember, what was promised, what is still open. It reads this client book and the rest of your memory. Each question uses the model (and may use credits).
know.byModel: Written by the model on {{date}}. Check against the sources.
know.noSources: Nothing about this client was found in the rest of your memory: this summary only uses the client book.
memory.toggle: Also write client notes into Mnemosyne's memory
memory.explain: They go into MnemoCRM's own vault, walled off from the rest until you open it from the Vault panel. Your client files stay in your folder either way.
memory.sent: {{count}} note(s) sent to the memory (the ones it already had are not duplicated).
memory.idle: New notes go to the memory as you write them.
memory.failed: Some notes did not reach the memory: {{error}}. They are safe in your folder; send the book again from Stages & settings.
settings.languageHint: For this computer only. The stage names you wrote stay as you wrote them.
demo.title: Demo book
demo.body: Creates a complete example book (a ceramicist's clients, deals, pieces, two markets, sales, a cancelled sale, a cash box that does not match) in an EMPTY folder you choose. Your own book is not touched, and one button brings you back to it.
demo.notEmpty: This folder already holds a book. Choose an empty folder: a demo never writes over real data.
demo.banner: Demo book: these clients and sales are examples, not real.
product.pictogramHint: Shown large when the piece has no photo.
analytics.noPrevious: No sale in the period before: nothing to compare with.
analytics.empty: No sale in this period yet. Write one from the Sales tab, or create a demo book in Settings.
analytics.noKnownClient: No sale is linked to a client in this period: pick the client when writing a sale.
analytics.knownShare: {{share}} of sales have a known client.
analytics.h.noStep: Open deals with no next step
license.body.clients: Without a license, a book holds {{clients}} clients. A Mnemosyne OS license removes the limit.
license.body.products: Without a license, a catalogue holds {{products}} products for sale. Sold unique pieces do not count. A Mnemosyne OS license removes the limit.
license.body.pdf: Reading a PDF catalogue uses the engines of Mnemosyne OS: page rendering, a model that sees, and the image memory. It comes with a Mnemosyne OS license. CSV and Excel imports stay free.
license.keeps: Everything already in your book stays: nothing is hidden or locked.
license.stillNone: Still no license on this machine.
license.walletOpened: The wallet is open in Mnemosyne OS. Come back here once the license is active, then check again.
import.title: Import a list
import.csvHint: Exported from a spreadsheet, a shop or another CRM.
import.pdfHint: Products, prices, details and photos read from the pages.
import.room.clients: Without a license: room for {{room}} more clients (limit {{limit}}).
import.room.products: Without a license: room for {{room}} more products for sale (limit {{limit}}).
import.mojibake: This file is not in UTF-8: accented letters will come out wrong. In your spreadsheet, save it again as "CSV UTF-8", or import the .xlsx directly.
import.hasHeader: The first row holds the column names
import.field.name: Name
import.duplicates.one: 1 already in the book, set aside
import.duplicates.many: {{count}} already in the book, set aside
import.overLimit.one: 1 row past the free limit of {{limit}}, not imported.
import.overLimit.many: {{count}} rows past the free limit of {{limit}}, not imported.
import.needName: Choose which column holds the name: a record without a name cannot be found again.
import.failedRead: The file could not be read: {{error}}
import.error.NOT_TEXT: this is not a text file.
import.error.NOT_A_WORKBOOK: this is not an Excel workbook (.xlsx).
import.error.NOT_A_ZIP: this is not an Excel workbook (.xlsx). An old .xls must be saved again as .xlsx.
pdf.title: Import a PDF catalogue
pdf.intro: Pick your catalogue. Each page is read by a model that sees: product names, prices, details, and the photo of each piece, cut out of the page. You review everything before anything is added.
pdf.textReading: Reading the text of the PDF…
pdf.cost.one: Reading it takes 1 call to the model, which may spend credits.
pdf.cost.many: Reading it takes {{count}} calls to the model (one per page), which may spend credits.
pdf.tooLong: Only the first {{max}} pages are read; {{skipped}} pages will be left out.
pdf.noVision: The model chosen in Mnemosyne OS cannot see images, so it cannot find the photos. It can still read the text: names, prices and details, without photos.
pdf.textOnlyNote: Read from the text: no photos.
pdf.stopped: Stopped before the end: the pages after were not read.
pdf.room: Without a license: room for {{room}} more products for sale.
pdf.nothing: No product was found in this PDF.
pdf.badPrice: A price is not readable: correct it or empty it.
pdf.photoFailed.one: 1 photo could not be saved: that product was added without it.
pdf.photoFailed.many: {{count}} photos could not be saved: those products were added without them.
pdf.failed: The PDF could not be read: {{error}}
